summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the newly Inertia/Vue-converted auction detail page (Auctions/Show.vue) on the preview URL, as guest and as buyer@test.com, at 1920x1080 and 390x844. First-load parity is excellent: title/badges/price hero/stats/seller card/bid feed/gallery all render, no Vue errors, countdown ticks, live-state + chat polling fire (~3 and ~2 requests per 8s), viewer count goes from '—' to a real number, quick-bid buttons populate the input (setQuick), lightbox opens/closes, mobile sticky bar + mobile timer work, seller actions navigate (/messages/1, /u/seller). TWO CRITICAL defects found: (1) On Inertia SPA re-entry to the page the re-injected auction-show.js throws 'Identifier _cdInterval has already been declared' and the entire realtime layer dies (0 live-state, 0 chat polls, viewer count stuck '—', price/feed no longer live, chat form + Enter key not bound); the timer only *looks* alive because the previous mount's timerInt interval is never cleared. (2) POST /auctions/{slug}/bid returns HTTP 500 ('Pusher error: {"error":"Unauthorized"}') so the UI shows a red error and never updates, even though the bid IS persisted (DB row created, current_price updated) - Reverb/broadcast backend is down. The polling->feed update path itself was proven working by spoofing CURRENT_USER_ID (price 20.160->20.400 ₺, count 13->14, feed 13->14 items, badge + quick buttons recomputed).

critical.issue: Returns 500 'Pusher error: {"error":"Unauthorized"}' from broadcast(new BidPlaced($bid)) because BROADCAST_CONNECTION=reverb but no Reverb server is running (no supervisor program for it). The bid is already written to DB and current_price updated BEFORE the exception, so data is saved but the client sees a failure and the UI never updates -> user retries and can double-bid. Fix: wrap the broadcast in try/catch (or dispatch afterResponse/queued) and/or run reverb under supervisor.

ui_bugs.issue: SPA re-entry breaks all realtime behaviour. Repro: open /auctions/antika-masa-saati-ve-vazo-seti-RYlQ -> click sidebar 'Ana Sayfa' (Inertia Link) -> browser Back. Console: PAGEERROR "Identifier '_cdInterval' has already been declared". Cause: onMounted re-injects auction-show.js, but the file declares top-level let/const (_cdInterval, peerConnection, pollInterval, chatInterval, remainingSecs, timerInt, ICE_SERVERS, MEMBERS...) in a classic script; the globals from the first load still exist, so the whole file fails at parse time and its DOMContentLoaded-queue init never runs. Measured after return: live-state requests in 6s = 0, chat requests = 0, #viewer-count and #live-viewer-stat stuck at '—', price/bid-feed no longer live-update, #chatForm submit and bid-input Enter handlers unbound. The visible ticking timer is a FALSE POSITIVE: __auctionShowCleanup does not clearInterval(timerInt), so the previous mount's interval keeps writing into the new page's #live-timer (and would show the WRONG remaining time if SPA-navigating between two different auctions).

After a submit attempt the button renders a duplicated icon ('⚡ ⚡ Teklif Ver') because _doSubmit sets #bid-btn-text.innerHTML to ' Teklif Ver' while the template already has a sibling . Parity with old Blade, but still a visual bug.

The 'Canlı Sohbet' card is nested inside #panel-stream, and #tab-stream carries d-none whenever the auction has no promo video and is not live -> the chat form/history is completely unreachable for ordinary auctions (chat input not visible on auction 1 even when logged in). Same structure as the old Blade file (parity), so not a regression, but confirm this is intended.

integration_issues.issue: Quick-bid fills input correctly (19920) and submit fires POST, but the response is 500 so #bid-error shows 'Pusher error: {"error":"Unauthorized"}' and #live-price / #live-bid-count / feed do not update; the bid is nonetheless stored (bids id=132, amount 20160, auctions.current_price=20160). Own-bid price refresh via polling is intentionally skipped (bidder_id === CURRENT_USER_ID), so with the 500 the user sees no feedback at all.
No /live-state or /chat requests are issued at all after an Inertia back-navigation to the page (see CRITICAL ui_bug above).

issues: Countdown is formatted mm:ss only, so multi-day auctions display nonsense-looking values like '6439:50' (=107 hours) and '8775:23'. Pre-existing in auction-show.js; consider d/h/m formatting.

auction-show.css hides .bid-column entirely, so the price hero, Teklif/Kalan/İzleyici stats, seller card (incl. 'Satıcıya Mesaj Gönder'/'Profili Gör') and the whole 'Teklif Akışı' feed are invisible on mobile; only the sticky bottom bar remains. Unchanged CSS = parity with Blade, but it is a real UX gap.
The mobile sticky 'Kalan Süre' value renders in red (critical styling) even though ~4 days remain.

action_items: Make auction-show.js re-entrant: wrap the whole file in an IIFE that stores state on window (or export window.__auctionShowInit/__auctionShowCleanup and call init() on remount instead of re-injecting the <script>). Today every SPA re-entry throws a redeclaration SyntaxError and kills polling/chat/timer init.

Add clearInterval(timerInt) (and _hideSellCountdown/_teardownLive) to window.__auctionShowCleanup so the countdown interval does not leak across Inertia navigations and write stale time into the next auction's #live-timer.

Fix bid 500: guard broadcast(new BidPlaced($bid)) with try/catch (or queue it) so a down Reverb/Pusher connection cannot fail an already-committed bid; optionally run reverb under supervisor for the preview env.
Fix duplicated lightning icon on the bid button after submit (#bid-btn-text innerHTML).
Decide whether live chat should be reachable when there is no stream tab (currently hidden inside #panel-stream), and whether the seller card / bid feed should be visible on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: Show.vue uses inline HTML onclick strings ('switchTab(...)', 'openLightbox(this.src)') and an interpolated :onclick="`switchImg(this,'${img.url}')`" - an image URL containing a quote breaks/injects JS. Prefer Vue @click handlers calling window fns.

The DOMContentLoaded shim at the top of auction-show.js monkeypatches document.addEventListener globally and only restores it at the very bottom of the file; any runtime error in between would leave the patch installed and silently swallow DOMContentLoaded listeners app-wide. Use try/finally or the IIFE/init approach.

onUnmounted removes the <script> tags but global side effects (declarations, document keydown listener for Escape, leaked intervals) persist - the current 'reload the script' strategy is fundamentally incompatible with classic top-level let/const.

auction-show.js mutates the Vue-rendered #bid-feed / .quick-btn DOM directly (addBidToFeed, updateStats). It works today only because the props are never refreshed; any future Inertia partial reload of 'a' will wipe the JS-inserted nodes.

success_rate.frontend: 5/7 scenarios pass (page load, timer, polling, gallery/lightbox, mobile) - bidding POST fails 500 and SPA re-entry breaks realtime; chat untestable because the chat panel is hidden for non-stream auctions

seed_data_creation: Two real bids were placed on auction id=1 as buyer@test.com during testing (bids id=132 amount 20160, and one more at 20400; auctions.current_price is now 20400). No other data created.
test_credentials: buyer@test.com / password (works; login inputs are type=text for email, use input.nth(0))
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified working on first load: render parity, badges (Aktif/CANLI/izleyici), price hero + Hemen Satın Al, stats row, seller card/rating/message+profile navigation, 12-item ranked bid feed, lightbox open+close, quick-bid setQuick, mobile sticky bar/timer, live-state polling ~2.5s and chat polling ~3s, viewer count updating. The polling->UI update path was proven by setting window.CURRENT_USER_ID=-999 then POSTing a bid: price/count/badge/feed/quick-buttons all updated - reuse that trick since own bids are intentionally skipped by pollLiveState. NOTE: auction card links in /browse/auctions are plain <a> (full page loads), so to reproduce the SPA regression you must use an Inertia Link (sidebar 'Ana Sayfa') and then page.go_back(). Ignore /storage/auctions/*.jpg 403s.
rca_of_the_issue: auction-show.js is a classic (non-module) script whose top-level declarations use let/const. Show.vue's onMounted appends the script again on every mount and onUnmounted only removes the <script> element, which does not remove the global lexical bindings. On the second mount the browser aborts the file at parse time with 'Identifier _cdInterval has already been declared', so nothing in it executes - including the bottom shim that flushes the queued DOMContentLoaded init - hence no timer start, no pollLiveState/pollChat intervals and no chat form binding. Separately, __auctionShowCleanup clears pollInterval/chatInterval/_cdInterval but not timerInt, so the first mount's 1s countdown interval survives navigation and keeps updating #live-timer by id, masking the failure. The bid 500 is unrelated to the conversion: BROADCAST_CONNECTION=reverb with no Reverb server makes broadcast() throw BroadcastException after the bid has already been committed.
